rows.name: Capital Dividend
rows.rationale: The native description explicitly gives skin a slight warm glow while remaining at 1 HP. A warm masked skin sheen suggests survival; no instant full wound healing or standing action.

rows.name: Create Food
rows.rationale: Conjured bland food supports six Medium creatures at base rank. Six soft food impressions at the hand-level casting location are explicit symbolic food substitutes; actual placement and higher-rank feeding counts are not invented.

rows.name: Creation
rows.rationale: Unchosen earth/plant matter (or heightened metal) becomes one temporary object. Gathering particles and a stationary object impression avoid choosing a sword, precious gem or actual scene object.

rows.name: False Vitality
rows.rationale: Necromantic energy augments flesh and grants temporary HP. An inward body contour and necromantic ward distinguish it from actual wound healing or undead transformation.

rows.name: Fey Disappearance
rows.rationale: Fey concealment and passage through natural difficult terrain produce a leaf-bound fading silhouette. The real token remains untouched; no teleport destination or attack occurs.

rows.name: Ghostly Carrier
rows.rationale: A Tiny semicorporeal chosen figure hovers near caster to carry later touch spells. One small hovering silhouette is an explicit substitute; no current ranged attack or immediate delivery-and-return is fabricated.

rows.name: Helpful Scribe
rows.rationale: A floating quill copies an existing page into a blank page over time. A tiny featherlike impression traces ink signs near caster hands; feather art is symbolic, and no translation or instantly copied whole book is claimed.

rows.name: Transcribe Conflict
rows.rationale: A detailed record of a recent combat appears on paper in the caster hand. One flat runic record impression and an insight eye distinguish it from an external attack replay or ghost battle.

rows.name: Ephemeral Tracking
rows.rationale: Caster senses see air-water tracks left by earlier passing creatures. Clear eye cues and a subtle current trace illustrate detection; the historic route is unknown and no physical creature moves now.

rows.name: Hypercognition
rows.rationale: Up to six Recall Knowledge actions rapidly collate relevant information. Six arranged mental impressions converge into one divinatory insight; no forced spell or creature movement.

rows.name: Nothing Up My Sleeve
rows.rationale: Each sleeve gains a private extradimensional object store. Two tiny hand-level pocket entrances distinguish it from a whole-token teleport; contents are not pulled, dropped or ejected now.

rows.name: Liminal Doorway
rows.rationale: A chalk drawing on an unbroken surface opens a room. A desaturated vertical frame suggests the drawn entrance; actual surface and subsequent entry/collapse need location context, not enemy-target teleport.

rows.name: Runic Impression
rows.rationale: One chosen property rune empowers a weapon or unarmed attacks. A small neutral hand-level inscription avoids default flaming footage, assumed weapon type or an immediate Strike.

rows.name: Whirling Scarves
rows.rationale: Colorful scarves of force whirl around caster and can snag later failed attacks. Multicolored energy ribbons are an explicit cloth substitute; the cast does not snag an enemy weapon or spin the real caster.

rows.name: Warding Aggression
rows.rationale: An immediate melee Strike attempts to plant a defensive foe ward. A restrained lunge and contact attempt precede a caster ward, avoiding a ranged cast-only cue or assumed sword; ward strength depends on attack result.

rows.name: Vicious Howl
rows.rationale: A passionate caster howl grants temporary HP and damage potential. Mouth-centered voice rings then a body reinforcement distinguish the self empowerment from attacking every nearby foe.

rows.name: Inevitable Destination
rows.rationale: The caster binds an enemy path toward caster. A neutral inward tether and foot-level path mark illustrate restriction; only critical failure pulls/prones, so no automatic movement at casting.

rows.name: Speak with Animals
rows.rationale: Animal conversation becomes possible without making animals more friendly. Ear-mouth language signs at caster replace calming hearts or creature control.

rows.name: Wanderer's Guide
rows.rationale: An inspired overland route to a chosen destination affects later travel outside encounters. Directional insight at caster is symbolic; the unknown route and actual Stride are not fabricated.

rows.name: Traveler's Transit
rows.rationale: Caster muscles gain swim/climb (or heightened fly) capability. Two limb-level reinforcement patches avoid choosing water wings or performing immediate movement without knowing the selected Speed.

rows.name: Safe Passage
rows.rationale: The complete native description defines a protected terrain section 10 feet wide, 10 feet tall and 60 feet long, despite structured area being null. Protective abjuration signs tile this corridor footprint; actual route and origin need placed-template context. No damage, removed difficult terrain or prematurely collapsed hazards.

previewArea.details: 10 feet wide, 10 feet tall, and 60 feet long

rows.name: Aromatic Lure
rows.rationale: A false scent targets olfaction and an independently chosen safe square. Inward head-level wisps illustrate attraction; do not move the target toward caster or invent the later lure square.

rows.name: Beastmaster Trance
rows.rationale: Caster senses mute while companion sight opens. Paired eye cues and a dim caster echo distinguish this from animal control; no attack or immediate movement.

rows.name: Charitable Urge
rows.rationale: The target offers a chosen possession on its next turn. A hand-level gift impulse illustrates the enchantment without dropping actual equipment or choosing stunned.

rows.name: Compel True Name
rows.rationale: Spoken true-name runes form a command seal. Commands, target obedience and name revelation depend on choices and saves, not a damaging ray.

rows.name: Delusional Pride
rows.rationale: A gleaming upper silhouette conveys overconfidence. Penalties depend on later failed checks; no injury or knockdown during casting.

rows.name: Empathic Link
rows.rationale: A willing emotional link marks both participants and sends quiet strands both ways. This is not one-way information or harmful mental lightning.

rows.name: Excise Lexicon
rows.rationale: A chosen mundane word is suppressed. Runic fragments disperse from the head; no actor language data or general knowledge is erased.

rows.name: Favorable Review
rows.rationale: Speech about a chosen subject becomes praise. Mouth-level runes curl upward; ordinary failure need not change attitude, so no forced love or bow.

rows.name: Impart Empathy
rows.rationale: An animal understands social cues. Eye and heart impressions appear near the head without pretending willingness to help or changing the creature type.

rows.name: Infectious Ennui
rows.rationale: Mental lethargy settles on the primary target. Secondary transmission occurs on a later turn; no immediate chain or fall is invented.

rows.name: Invent Code
rows.rationale: A willing group gains a shared private code. Three arranged vocabulary signs appear at participants; this is not public translation or a sonic spell.

rows.name: Laughing Fit
rows.rationale: Upper-body laughter and soft sound ripples distinguish this from mental damage. Prone belongs only to a critical failure and is not pre-resolved.

rows.name: Manifestation of Spirits
rows.rationale: Illusory spirits crowd the target mind. Local spectral veils suggest the personal visions; they are not actual summoned creatures or a damaging aura.

rows.name: Mental Map
rows.rationale: Location memories flow from target back to caster. The learned map and optional critical-failure erasure are not fabricated on canvas.

rows.name: Overwhelming Memory
rows.rationale: The caster chooses gleeful, romantic, terrifying or tragic memory. Neutral layered memory impressions preserve that unresolved choice instead of always showing fear.

rows.name: Roaring Applause
rows.rationale: Paired hand-level glints and rising sound rings suggest cheers and applause. No generic lightning jolt or physical fall.

rows.name: Shift Blame
rows.rationale: A reaction edits the remembered responsible creature. Overlapping memory impressions illustrate substitution; the independently chosen blamed participant is not guessed.

rows.name: Spiritual Anamnesis
rows.rationale: An earlier life intrudes into the present. A spiritual duplicate rises behind the recipient; undead/extraplanar save adjustment remains rules.

rows.name: Stupefy
rows.rationale: The target mind dulls. A blurred head impression and small unfocused stars replace a full-body attack or fear vision.

rows.name: Subjugate Undead
rows.rationale: A necromantic command seal is attempted on one undead. The binding is finite and symbolic; minion control and immunity require the native save.

rows.name: Sudden Recollection
rows.rationale: Knowledge is planted or suppressed until a chosen later trigger. Rune fragments seal inward at casting; no premature revelation or recall is played.

rows.name: Timely Tutor
rows.rationale: Physical contact connects an eidolon or familiar to the Akashic psychic library. A small library portal and matching knowledge marks illustrate the connection, not attack or movement.

rows.name: Vicious Jealousy
rows.rationale: Social bonds become resentment. Outward mental threads and a dimmed heart indicate lost alliance; later berating actions are not performed during casting.

rows.name: With Friends like These
rows.rationale: Two targets receive diverging social impressions. No caster-target friendship bond, immediate forced separation or assumed save result.

rows.name: Word of Freedom
rows.rationale: A liberating word suppresses a selected mental or physical restriction. A word pulse opens outward rather than assuming every target is physically chained.

rows.name: Appeal to Authority
rows.rationale: A subtle mental likeness of an authority figure affects an impression. A restrained eye/seal cue avoids summoning a real NPC or forcing obedience.

rows.name: Befuddle
rows.rationale: Opposing thought signs cross around unfocused stars. Confusion is a critical-failure branch, so no random forced movement occurs.

rows.name: Celestial Accord
rows.rationale: Two creatures in conflict calm. Matching gentle head marks replace wound healing or a caster-target emotional bond.

rows.name: Charming Touch
rows.rationale: One touched recipient receives a small attraction mark. Friendliness and awareness depend on the save; no forced body motion.

rows.name: Déjà Vu
rows.rationale: A short translucent repetition evokes repeating the next turn again. No actual actions, teleport or extra attack are executed now.

rows.name: Elysian Whimsy
rows.rationale: Four possible later whimsical outcomes require the native roll. Loose stars and fluttering impressions convey potential without blindly choosing dancing, singing or charity.

rows.name: Guided Introspection
rows.rationale: Ordered inner circles evoke a willing subject reflecting on emotion and fear. This strengthens future defenses; no existing condition is falsely cleansed now.

rows.name: Heart's Hook
rows.rationale: Two targets feel inward attraction and may approach each other on a later turn. Paired local heart marks distinguish this from caster-target love or actual movement.

rows.name: Information Overload
rows.rationale: Several irrelevant knowledge fragments cascade around the head, ending in small unfocused stars. No damaging ray or musical performance.

rows.name: Join Pasts
rows.rationale: Two willing foreheads share nonverbal past experience. Matching eye impressions and memory veils avoid spoken-code letters and one-way Mindlink.

rows.name: Message Rune
rows.rationale: A small personal rune stores a telepathic message for a later trigger. The mark is quiet and local; the message is not audibly played at casting.

rows.name: Mindlink
rows.rationale: A willing touched target receives information from caster once. A single outward strand and recipient eye cue avoid an ongoing bidirectional emotional bond.

rows.name: Schadenfreude
rows.rationale: Smug amusement distracts foes following the caster critical failure. A brief head glint and mild wobble replace replaying the failed attack.

rows.name: Share Lore
rows.rationale: Ordered knowledge symbols reach willing recipients. It grants selected training without flooding them with confusing unrelated information.

rows.name: Tame
rows.rationale: Comforting natural signs and a small heart cue suggest a nonhostile domesticated animal approach. No immediate bow, attack, wild-beast domination or attitude success is assumed.

rows.name: Touch of Obedience
rows.rationale: A hand-level seal and restrained thought threads weaken will. No kneeling; prone belongs only to critical failure.

rows.name: Uplifting Overture
rows.rationale: Music at caster prepares a future Aid; a recipient glint illustrates encouragement. No wound healing or future successful check is played.

rows.name: Veil of Dreams
rows.rationale: Descending dream stars and head haze evoke drowsy daydreams. The spell does not impose sleep or unconsciousness, so the real token remains upright.

rows.name: Wilding Word
rows.rationale: A patron growl warns an animal fungus or plant. Head-level warning eyes and caster voice rings do not apply the sickness that occurs only if the target later harms caster.

rows.name: Aberrant Form
rows.rationale: Grotesque tentacular material and an asymmetric echo illustrate aberrant transformation. The chosen chuul/gogiteth/gug/ofalth is not inferred; exact creature artwork is unavailable.

rows.name: Angel Form
rows.rationale: Feathers and celestial light reveal a luminous silhouette. Choral/kuribu can be Small, so no universal enlargement or chosen weapon attack occurs; feather artwork is symbolic.

rows.name: Cosmic Form
rows.rationale: Stars gather into a body-fitted cosmic outline. Moon or sun is a player choice; no always-fire body or premature beam attack.

rows.name: Daemon Form
rows.rationale: Deathly smoke and an overlapping fiendish outline evoke Abaddon. Individual daemon bodies and attacks are not available as JB2A art; no specific poison or cold attack is guessed.

rows.name: Demon Form
rows.rationale: Rift energy opens around the changing silhouette. Distinct from daemon death smoke and devil ordered bindings; a particular demon or fire attack is not chosen.

rows.name: Devil Form
rows.rationale: Ordered infernal bindings and a contract-like seal evoke Hell. This does not claim all devil forms have chains or perform a chosen trident attack.

rows.name: Divine Vessel
rows.rationale: A recognizable existing body receives servitor-like luminous traces. Selected alignment is unresolved; avoid a random angel replacement or assumed damage type.

rows.name: Dragon Form
rows.rationale: Paired winglike accents and a broad scaled silhouette suggest transformation without breathing fire. Feathers are an explicit wing substitute; dragon species and breath selection remain manual.

rows.name: Mantle of Heaven's Slopes
rows.rationale: Heaven light sweeps the body and opens a luminous mantle. Two chosen powers may be eyes, hands, barriers, weapons or voice; no arbitrary pair is played.

rows.name: Mantle of the Melting Heart
rows.rationale: A silver liquid coating rises over skin and armor and leaves an oily shimmer. The two selected copper/gold/acid/cabled-fist powers are not assumed.

rows.name: Mantle of the Unwavering Heart
rows.rationale: Branches envelop the caster, then a wild bloom opens into colored leaves. No perfume sickness, healing or Large-size option is chosen automatically.

rows.name: Plant Form
rows.rationale: Verdant growth and branchlike material build around the silhouette. The selected arboreal/flytrap and specific plant are not invented; growth art is symbolic.

rows.name: Sacred Form
rows.rationale: A recognizable body receives luminous armament glints and divine energy. The deity favored weapon is unresolved; no default sword or attack is spawned.

rows.name: Tempest Form
rows.rationale: The body outline blurs into an amorphous shimmer. Air, water or mist is a player choice; no always-water wave, invisibility document change or electrical attack.

rows.name: Tentacular Innervation
rows.rationale: One limb extends into a tentacular mass for an immediate reach-extended unarmed Strike. Local caster arm material precedes the target contact; sickened/grabbed follow a successful Strike rather than mere morph casting.

rows.name: Collective Transposition
rows.rationale: Several independent chosen positions within a 30-foot emanation are unresolved. Localized participant signs illustrate transposition potential; do not teleport all targets to caster.

rows.name: Ethereal Jaunt
rows.rationale: Caster phases into the overlapping Ethereal Plane with a gray hazy outline. No generic exit gate, enemy-target teleport or automatic falling-on-return is invented.

rows.name: Fire's Pathway
rows.rationale: The caster steps into a sufficiently large existing fire; departure uses flame and heat wisps. The other fire can be miles away and is not guessed from targeted enemies.

rows.name: Interplanar Teleport
rows.rationale: A planar-key mark prepares a group crossing. The destination plane and imprecise arrival are unresolved; no invented adjacent portal destination.

rows.name: King's Castle
rows.rationale: Caster and a willing creature exchange their known spaces. Both participants receive paired gates and opposing phase echoes; actual document positions remain native/player rules.

rows.name: Maze of Locked Doors
rows.rationale: An extradimensional enclosure closes around the target with layered lock-like marks. It is not beneficial transit or an immediate successful escape; door count depends on the save.

rows.name: Momentary Recovery
rows.rationale: A visible intervening recovery interval separates departure and return impression. The chosen clear destination and private interim actions are not fabricated.

rows.name: Nature's Pathway
rows.rationale: A living-tree entrance is depicted with rising growth and leaves instead of blue generic portals. The remote tree is unknown; no enemy-target teleport.

rows.name: Proximal Shift
rows.rationale: Departure matter tears away with debris at caster. Arrival debris and its victims require an independently chosen destination; no explosion is wrongly placed on the current enemy target.

rows.name: Shadow Jump
rows.rationale: A dark opening envelops caster with a shadowy phase echo. The chosen dim destination, familiar and heightened invisibility remain native/contextual choices.

rows.name: Spiritual Transport
rows.rationale: Spiritual impressions and mist gather for transport. A familiar or companion is optional context; no arbitrary enemy arrival or extra creature motion.

rows.name: Terrain Transposition
rows.rationale: Wilderness material folds around the caster. Actual terrain, destination and adjacent companion are unresolved; leaves are a symbolic natural-terrain accent.

rows.name: Tesseract Tunnel
rows.rationale: A space-tunnel entrance prepares before a Stride creates its second endpoint. No fake second gate at an enemy or immediate teleport instead of the required movement.

rows.name: Umbral Journey
rows.rationale: Willing travelers take on hazy shadow outlines for hours of Netherworld travel. This differs from instant local Shadow Jump; no immediate remote arrival is fabricated.

rows.name: Unexpected Transposition
rows.rationale: Reactive paired phase marks illustrate a possible swap with another creature. The triggering attacker is not the swap partner; saves and the redirected attack remain native resolution.

rows.name: Cleanse Affliction
rows.rationale: A selected curse disease or poison is pushed back, not necessarily cured. A contracting contaminant veil and protective sign distinguish affliction-stage reduction from wound healing.

rows.name: Clear Mind
rows.rationale: Mental contamination moves outward from the head and eyes become clear. Counteract or temporary suppression is not guaranteed; no body wound-heal burst.

rows.name: Familiar's Resurrection
rows.rationale: The familiar master bond reconnects a small life spark, then a brief healing flare suggests return at 1 HP. No general full healing or corpse replacement.

rows.name: Fated Healing
rows.rationale: Two hostile creatures receive a peaceful bond. Healing occurs at their own turn ends and ends for a hostile participant; no immediate heal or caster-target transfer.

rows.name: Heal
rows.rationale: Vital energy restores the living or damages undead. The normal finite restoration flare avoids making every use a beam; native 1/2/3-action range and area remain system context.

rows.name: Heal Animal
rows.rationale: Natural wound restoration on one willing living animal includes leaf accents, not a humanoid holy seal or animal transformation.1/2-action range remains native.

rows.name: Heal Companion
rows.rationale: An intimate companion heart mark accompanies focused wound restoration. This does not teleport companion to caster or heal every creature in an area.

rows.name: Luminous Stardust Healing
rows.rationale: Twinkling sparks from the sentinel weapon scatter onto the ally and replenish spirit. Possession removal is a counteract branch, not guaranteed ghost ejection.

rows.name: Necromancer's Generosity
rows.rationale: Void energy travels outward along the magical connection to an undead minion, then a necromantic ward settles. No green vitality heal or damage assumed on the minion.

rows.name: Restoration
rows.rationale: A burden is reduced from the body without restoring HP. Toxin/condition choice is unresolved, so neutral outward relief avoids claiming a complete poison cure.

rows.name: Sound Body
rows.rationale: A body-fitted restorative sweep pushes out physical contamination. It counters/suppresses selected sensory or physical conditions; no guaranteed healing or specific eye-only cure.

rows.name: Spirit Link
rows.rationale: Caster life supports the target while caster takes its pain. A neutral outward spirit strand and paired body signs avoid reversing transfer or using vitality/void artwork. Later turn repeats are not played now.

rows.name: Stabilize
rows.rationale: A small steady life spark settles low on the dying target. It remains unconscious at 0 HP, so no standing motion or wound restoration is shown.

rows.name: Sure Footing
rows.rationale: Two lower-body freedom signs and outward fragments illustrate mobility restored. No immediate Stride, physical chains on every target or guaranteed counteract success.

rows.name: Devour Life
rows.rationale: Void damage consumes a living target and life force moves from victim back into caster. Target-origin strands and a caster inward field distinguish this from healing the victim; actual healing depends on dealt damage.

rows.name: Breath of Life
rows.rationale: A brief strong life spark intervenes at the moment a living creature would die. No soul teleport, later general resurrection or automatic standing.

rows.name: Life Connection
rows.rationale: A hidden life-saving failsafe is planted. An inward ward and small heart mark prepare the later Defend Life reaction; no immediate healing.

rows.name: Life Pact
rows.rationale: Willing participants receive matching quiet pact marks. HP transfer occurs only when someone would fall to0; no early healing beam or arbitrary victim chosen.

rows.name: Revival
rows.rationale: A large healing flare and ephemeral second silhouette suggest living healing and temporary return of dead targets. Living/dead target distinction is unresolved, so no rules/document resurrection or standing motion.

rows.name: Vital Beacon
rows.rationale: A luminous body beacon prepares later touch-based healing in four diminishing uses. A cast aura and four small potential glints avoid immediately healing targeted allies.

rows.name: Summon Anarch
rows.rationale: Chaotic summoning signs diverge around the invocation. Selected celestial/monitor/fiend, placement and later combat are unresolved; no creature artwork or automatic Strike is claimed.

rows.name: Summon Ancient Fleshforged
rows.rationale: A flesh-and-gate invocation remains neutral until Bone Breaker/Thorn Caller/Thousand/Scion choice. Their incompatible arrival areas and later departure attacks cannot safely be merged; exact fleshforged art is unavailable.

rows.name: Summon Axiom
rows.rationale: Ordered signs converge into a summoning frame, distinct from Anarch divergence. Selected lawful creature and placement remain unresolved.

rows.name: Summon Celestial
rows.rationale: Celestial feather/light casting accents distinguish the invocation. No particular celestial body, later attack or placement is invented.

rows.name: Summon Dragon
rows.rationale: Paired winglike casting accents frame draconic potential without default fire breath. Feathers are a symbolic wing substitute; species/tradition and placement remain native choices.

rows.name: Summon Elemental
rows.rationale: A neutral elemental field prepares the invocation. Fire/water/earth/air/metal/wood choice is unresolved, so no always-fire elemental or premature damage.

rows.name: Summon Entity
rows.rationale: Warped tentacular gate material suggests an aberrant invocation. It is an explicit symbolic substitute, not actual summoned aberration art or an attack on targets.

rows.name: Summon Fiend
rows.rationale: A smoky unholy gate prepares the invocation, distinct from celestial feather light. Selected fiend, scene position and later attacks remain unresolved.

rows.name: Summon Giant
rows.rationale: A broad heavy casting frame suggests giant scale. It does not enlarge caster, shake all foes or claim exact giant artwork/placement.

rows.name: Summon Irii
rows.rationale: Temporal divination signs pause and echo as the invocation prepares. Fate/fortune changes distinct arrive/depart effects; neither chosen outcome or departure is played blindly.

rows.name: Summon Monitor
rows.rationale: A balanced planar frame and protective signs prepare monitor summoning. Different monitors are not represented as one creature, and placement remains unresolved.

rows.name: Summon Oliphaunt of Jandelay
rows.rationale: A broad force-gate casting invocation suggests immense Jandelay scale. Arrival in a 60-foot burst, a later trample 200 feet long and 80 feet wide, and the actual Gargantuan token require location and heading context; no premature or wrongly centered damage.

rows.name: Summon Stampede
rows.rationale: Staggered foot-level ground tremors suggest the foreboding stampede invocation. Gargantuan arrival placement and the later 120-foot trample route are unresolved; no arbitrary beast art or immediate departure attack.

rows.name: Summon Warden of the Wild
rows.rationale: Natural spirit material prepares the invocation. Cave/forest/water/mountain biome changes incompatible arrival and departure effects; no always-vine damage or guessed warden choice.
